title: China discovers Jurassic flightless bird fossil, challenging traditional views on avian evolution
description: A newly discovered fossil of a Jurassic bird in China has challenged the long-held view that flight was the primary driving force behind the origin and early evolution of birds, researchers said.

title: 6-year-old fossil hunter makes rare discovery in Nebraska
description: A 6-year-old found a rare fossil at a Nebraska recreation area — the first of its kind in the state in more than 55 years.
